searchText: One argument against SSZ is backwards compatibility: If we introduce an SSZ BAL with a fixed 16 byte balance, we immediately deprecate support for any existing private testing chains and forks which have any accounts with a larger balance. If we use RLP, we can retain support for large balances because the encoded balance size is dynamic. Also worth noting that based on analysis of 50 mainnet blocks, SSZ adds a ~10% size overhead vs RLP.
